title: Weekends cost me sleep
finding: On Saturday and Sunday mornings I had slept 5.9 h on average, against 6.3 h on weekdays. 28 of 64 weekend nights were under 6 h; on weekdays it was 55 of 176.
caveat: Observational. Weekends also hold the late dinners and the travel, so the weekend is a bundle, not one cause.

title: I do not catch up the next night
finding: After a night under 6 h, the next night averaged 5.7 h. After a night of 7 h or more, 6.4 h. Short nights came in runs instead of being repaid.
caveat: The interval (-1.2 to -0.3 h) stays below zero, but it rests on 71 short nights, so treat it as likely, not settled.

title: Training days do not cost sleep
finding: Nights after a day with 30 or more minutes of training averaged 6.0 h; nights after a rest day, 6.2 h. The gap is -0.2 h and its interval (-0.6 to +0.1 h) includes zero.
caveat: A null result is still a result. It rules out the "I slept badly because I trained" story, for me.
